senses.en: a person who owns or is responsible for a house

example.en: Every householder in the street received a letter about the repairs.
example.zh: 这条街上的每户人家都收到了一封关于维修的信。

senses.en: in a fair way, without favoring either side

example.en: The judge listened to both sides impartially.
example.zh: 法官不偏不倚地听取了双方的陈述。

senses.en: a verb mood used to express wishes, possibilities, or hypothetical situations

example.en: In "If I were you," "were" is the subjunctive.
example.zh: 在“如果我是你”中，“were”是虚拟语气。

senses.en: relating to this verb mood

example.en: The subjunctive form is common in French.
example.zh: 虚拟语气形式在法语中很常见。

senses.en: very appropriate and fitting

example.en: She made an apposite comment during the meeting.
example.zh: 她在会上发表了一个十分贴切的评论。

senses.en: the gaseous layer of the sun's atmosphere above the photosphere, visible during a total solar eclipse

example.en: The chromosphere glows red during a total eclipse.
example.zh: 日全食期间色球层发出红光。

senses.en: to get on a horse or bicycle, or to climb up something

example.en: She mounted the horse and rode toward the gate.
example.zh: 她骑上马，朝大门骑去。

senses.en: to increase gradually in intensity or amount

example.en: Pressure mounted on the committee to release the report.
example.zh: 要求委员会公布报告的压力越来越大。

senses.en: to fix something in position so it can be used or displayed

example.en: He mounted the photograph on a piece of card.
example.zh: 他把照片装裱在一张卡纸上。

senses.en: goods or services sold to another country

example.en: The country's main export is coffee.
example.zh: 该国的主要出口产品是咖啡。

senses.en: to send goods to another country, or provide goods or services to foreign customers
senses.zh: 出口；对外提供（商品或服务）

example.en: They export machinery to several countries.
example.zh: 他们向几个国家出口机械。

senses.en: to transfer data from a program into another format

example.en: You can export the report as a PDF file.
example.zh: 你可以将报告导出为 PDF 文件。

senses.en: to cause something to begin

example.en: The company will initiate a review of its safety procedures.
example.zh: 公司将启动对其安全程序的审查。

senses.en: to formally admit someone into a group, often with a ceremony

example.en: The club initiated three new members last night.
example.zh: 俱乐部昨晚正式接纳了三名新成员。

senses.en: a person who has recently joined a group or begun learning something

example.en: Each initiate receives a handbook and a mentor.
example.zh: 每位新加入者都会收到一本手册和一位导师。

senses.en: to cut a design or shape into wood, stone, etc., or shape something by cutting

example.en: He carved a bird out of wood.
example.zh: 他用木头雕刻了一只鸟。

senses.en: to cut meat or a cooked dish into slices or pieces

example.en: Dad carved the roast chicken at dinner.
example.zh: 爸爸在晚餐时把烤鸡切开。

senses.en: the force that pulls objects toward each other, especially toward the Earth

example.en: An apple fell from the tree because of gravity.
example.zh: 苹果因为重力从树上掉了下来。

senses.en: seriousness or solemn manner

example.en: He spoke with great gravity about the crisis.
example.zh: 他神色庄重地谈到了这场危机。

senses.en: in every part of a place or thing

example.en: The festival is celebrated throughout the country.
example.zh: 这个节日在全国各地都有人庆祝。

senses.en: during the whole of a period of time

example.en: She remained calm throughout the interview.
example.zh: 整个面试过程中她始终保持冷静。

senses.en: in every part or during the whole time

example.en: The house was painted white throughout.
example.zh: 整栋房子都漆成了白色。

senses.en: a person who acts on behalf of another person or organization

example.en: The agent represents the client in negotiations.
example.zh: 代理人代表客户进行谈判。

senses.en: a force or substance that produces an effect

example.en: Heat is an agent of change in many materials.
example.zh: 热是许多材料发生变化的作用因素。

senses.en: a computer program that performs tasks automatically

example.en: The software agent checks for updates every hour.
example.zh: 该软件代理程序每小时检查一次更新。

senses.en: The activity of sharing information or ideas with others.
senses.zh: 与他人交流信息或想法的活动；沟通。

example.en: Good communication is essential for a healthy team.
example.zh: 良好的沟通对健康的团队至关重要。

senses.en: A message or piece of information sent to someone.
senses.zh: 传递给某人的消息或信息。

example.en: I received a communication from the bank about my account.
example.zh: 我收到银行关于我账户的一封来函。

senses.en: A way of sending information, such as by radio, telephone, or writing.
senses.zh: 传递信息的方式，如无线电、电话或书面方式；通信手段。

example.en: Radio is an important means of communication in remote areas.
example.zh: 无线电是偏远地区重要的通信手段。

senses.en: an event, especially one that is unusual, unpleasant, or serious
senses.zh: 事件（尤指不寻常、不愉快或严重的事件）

example.en: The meeting ended without incident.
example.zh: 会议顺利结束，没有发生意外。

senses.en: controlled behavior and the practice of following rules

example.en: Learning a language requires discipline and regular practice.
example.zh: 学习语言需要自律和经常练习。

senses.en: a branch of knowledge or study

example.en: Linguistics is an academic discipline with many branches.
example.zh: 语言学是一门拥有许多分支的学科。

senses.en: to train or punish someone so that they follow rules and control their behavior

example.en: The coach disciplined the player for breaking team rules.
example.zh: 教练因该球员违反队规而处分了他。

senses.en: Able to be seen.

example.en: The mountain was visible from our window.
example.zh: 从我们的窗户可以看到那座山。

senses.en: Easy to notice; obvious.

example.en: There was a visible improvement in her mood.
example.zh: 她的情绪有了明显的改善。

senses.en: a goal that you plan to achieve

example.en: Our main objective is to finish the report by Friday.
example.zh: 我们的主要目标是周五前完成报告。

senses.en: based on facts rather than personal feelings or opinions
senses.zh: 客观的；基于事实的；不受个人情感影响的

example.en: A good judge should remain objective when hearing the evidence.
example.zh: 优秀的法官在听取证据时应保持客观。

senses.en: the lens in a telescope or microscope that is nearest the object being viewed

example.en: The microscope's objective is the lens closest to the sample.
example.zh: 显微镜的物镜是最靠近样本的镜头。

senses.en: the broken parts left after something is destroyed

example.en: The divers explored the wreckage of the sunken ship.
example.zh: 潜水员探索了沉船的残骸。

senses.en: the destruction or ruin of something such as a plan or relationship

example.en: The scandal left the wreckage of his political career.
example.zh: 那场丑闻毁掉了他的政治生涯。

senses.en: having an end or limit; limited in size, amount, or extent

example.en: Earth's resources are finite, so we must use them carefully.
example.zh: 地球的资源是有限的，所以我们必须谨慎使用。

senses.en: relating to verb forms that show tense and agree with their subject

example.en: In English, every sentence needs a finite verb.
example.zh: 在英语中，每个句子都需要一个限定动词。

senses.en: a very tall building with many floors

example.en: The skyscraper rises above the city skyline.
example.zh: 这座摩天大楼高耸于城市天际线之上。

senses.en: to examine something in detail to understand it or discover essential features

example.en: The scientist will analyse the data before drawing any conclusions.
example.zh: 科学家将在得出结论前分析这些数据。

senses.en: to break something down into its components or parts

example.en: The tutor asked the student to analyse the sentence into its grammatical parts.
example.zh: 导师让学生把句子分解成语法成分。

senses.en: to judge the value or quality of something

example.en: An expert appraised the antique vase before the auction.
example.zh: 拍卖前，一位专家对这件古董花瓶进行了估价。

senses.en: introducing new ideas or ways of doing things

example.en: The company is known for its innovative designs.
example.zh: 这家公司以其创新的设计而闻名。

senses.en: extremely beautiful or impressive

example.en: She looked stunning in her red dress.
example.zh: 她穿红裙子美极了。

senses.en: very surprising or shocking

example.en: The team announced its stunning defeat.
example.zh: 该队宣布了令人震惊的失利。

senses.en: a painted cloth hung at the back of a stage

example.en: The backdrop showed a night sky full of stars.
example.zh: 背景幕上是一片布满星星的夜空。

senses.en: the general background situation for an event

example.en: The talks took place against a backdrop of rising tension.
example.zh: 会谈是在紧张局势不断升级的背景下进行的。

senses.en: to set or adjust something in advance

example.en: You can preset the radio to your favorite station.
example.zh: 你可以把收音机预调到你喜欢的电台。

senses.en: fixed or decided in advance

example.en: The oven comes with preset cooking modes.
example.zh: 这台烤箱带有预设的烹饪模式。

senses.en: a setting chosen in advance on a device

example.en: Save your settings as a preset for next time.
example.zh: 把你的设置保存为预设，以备下次使用。

senses.en: relating to the west or western parts of the world

example.en: Many Western countries celebrate Christmas in December.
example.zh: 许多西方国家在十二月庆祝圣诞节。

senses.en: a movie or book about cowboys and life in the American West

example.en: My grandfather loves watching old westerns on TV.
example.zh: 我爷爷喜欢在电视上看老西部片。

senses.en: relating to the western United States

example.en: They took a road trip through the western states last summer.
example.zh: 去年夏天他们开车游遍了西部各州。

senses.en: relating to the Olympic Games or Olympia in Greece
senses.zh: 奥林匹克的；奥林匹亚的

example.en: She won an Olympic gold medal in swimming.
example.zh: 她赢得了奥运会游泳金牌。

senses.en: to move through water using your arms and legs

example.en: She swims in the pool every morning.
example.zh: 她每天早上在游泳池游泳。

senses.en: to float on or in a liquid without sinking

example.en: The ducks were swimming on the lake.
example.zh: 鸭子在湖面上游水。

senses.en: an act or period of swimming

example.en: Let's go for a swim before dinner.
example.zh: 晚饭前我们去游个泳吧。

senses.en: covered with clouds; dull and grey

example.en: The sky was overcast all morning.
example.zh: 整个上午天空都阴沉沉的。

senses.en: relating to the stomach

example.en: The doctor ordered a gastric endoscopy.
example.zh: 医生安排了胃镜检查。

senses.en: a state of long sleep or inactivity in which some animals pass the winter

example.en: Bears wake up from hibernation in spring.
example.zh: 熊在春天从冬眠中醒来。

senses.en: the state of being easily affected by something

example.en: Older adults have a higher susceptibility to infections.
example.zh: 老年人对感染的易感性更高。

senses.en: tight clothing covering the body and legs, worn by dancers or women and girls

example.en: She bought a new pair of tights for the dance class.
example.zh: 她为舞蹈课买了一条新的紧身裤袜。

senses.en: dirty, run-down, and disreputable
senses.zh: 破败的，肮脏的，乌七八糟的

example.en: They stayed in a seedy motel near the station.
example.zh: 他们住在车站附近一家破旧肮脏的汽车旅馆。

senses.en: full of seeds

example.en: Overripe figs become seedy and soft.
example.zh: 过熟的无花果会变得多籽绵软。

senses.en: a sea fish with oily flesh, often eaten as food

example.en: We grilled fresh mackerel for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐烤了新鲜的鲭鱼。

senses.en: a strong feeling of displeasure or hostility

example.en: She spoke in anger and later apologized.
example.zh: 她愤怒地说了话，后来道了歉。

senses.en: to make someone feel angry

example.en: His rude remark angered the whole team.
example.zh: 他无礼的话激怒了整个团队。

senses.en: a program used to view websites
senses.zh: 浏览器；用于浏览网页的软件

example.en: She opened a browser to check her email.
example.zh: 她打开浏览器查看电子邮件。

senses.en: a person who looks through goods or information without necessarily buying

example.en: The shop was full of browsers on Saturday.
example.zh: 星期六店里挤满了随便看看的顾客。

senses.en: a person who is physically or mentally dependent on a substance, especially a drug

example.en: The clinic helps drug addicts recover.
example.zh: 这家诊所帮助吸毒成瘾者康复。

senses.en: a person who is very enthusiastic about something

example.en: My brother is a coffee addict and drinks five cups a day.
example.zh: 我哥哥是个咖啡迷，一天喝五杯。

senses.en: to cause someone to be dependent on something, usually passive (be addicted to)

example.en: He became addicted to online games during the holidays.
example.zh: 假期里他迷上了网络游戏。

senses.en: the main land mass of a country or region, as opposed to nearby islands

example.en: He took a ferry from the island to the mainland.
example.zh: 他乘渡船从岛上去大陆。

senses.en: behaving as if you are better or more important than others; too proud

example.en: His arrogant tone annoyed everyone in the meeting.
example.zh: 他傲慢的语气让会议上的每个人都感到恼火。

senses.en: an adult female chicken

example.en: The hen lays an egg almost every morning.
example.zh: 那只母鸡几乎每天早上都下一个蛋。

senses.en: the female of any bird, especially a game bird

example.en: A hen pheasant sheltered in the tall grass.
example.zh: 一只雌雉躲在深草丛中。

senses.en: a person in your family who lived long ago, from whom you are descended

example.en: My ancestors came to this country over a hundred years ago.
example.zh: 我的祖先在一百多年前来到这个国家。

senses.en: from a distant foreign country; strikingly unusual or exciting

example.en: She photographed exotic birds in the rainforest.
example.zh: 她在雨林里拍摄异国鸟类。

senses.en: a plant or animal not native to the place where it is found
senses.zh: 外来物种；引进的动植物

example.en: The garden contains several exotics from Asia.
example.zh: 这个花园里有几种来自亚洲的外来植物。

senses.en: a game or problem that tests your thinking, often with pieces to fit together or a question to solve

example.en: This jigsaw puzzle has a thousand pieces.
example.zh: 这幅拼图有一千块。

senses.en: something that is hard to understand or explain

example.en: Her sudden disappearance remains a puzzle.
example.zh: 她的突然失踪仍是个谜。

senses.en: to make someone confused because something is hard to understand

example.en: The strange noise puzzled the neighbors.
example.zh: 奇怪的响声让邻居们感到困惑。

senses.en: to think hard about something difficult to understand

example.en: He puzzled over the math problem all evening.
example.zh: 他一晚上都在苦思那道数学题。

senses.en: a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking

example.en: She bought the dress on impulse.
example.zh: 她一时冲动买下了那条裙子。

senses.en: a push or force that starts something moving; a driving force

example.en: The rocket got its initial impulse from the booster.
example.zh: 火箭的初始冲力来自助推器。

senses.en: (electronics) a short burst of electrical signal

example.en: The device sends out a brief electrical impulse.
example.zh: 该装置发出一个短暂的电脉冲。

senses.en: to send or pass something from one person or place to another

example.en: The station transmits signals across the whole country.
example.zh: 该电台向全国传送信号。

senses.en: to spread a disease or infection to another person

example.en: The virus can be transmitted through close contact.
example.zh: 这种病毒可通过密切接触传播。

senses.en: to pass on knowledge, values, or a message to others

example.en: Parents transmit their values to their children.
example.zh: 父母把他们的价值观传递给子女。

senses.en: having highly developed industries

example.en: Japan is a highly industrialized country.
example.zh: 日本是一个高度工业化的国家。

senses.en: the folded and sewn edge of a piece of cloth or clothing

example.en: The hem of her skirt came undone.
example.zh: 她裙子的折边开线了。

senses.en: to fold and sew an edge of cloth

example.en: She hemmed the trousers to the right length.
example.zh: 她把裤边缝到合适的长度。

senses.en: to hesitate or pause in speech with sounds like 'er' or 'ahem'
senses.zh: 支吾，吞吞吐吐；发出清嗓子的声音

example.en: He hemmed and hawed before answering the question.
example.zh: 他支支吾吾，过了好一会儿才回答问题。

senses.en: the act or statement of proving something wrong

example.en: The lawyer offered a strong refutation of the accusation.
example.zh: 律师对这一指控提出了有力的反驳。

senses.en: not included on a list
senses.zh: 未列入名录的，未列出的

example.en: The hotel's phone number is unlisted.
example.zh: 这家酒店的电话号码未列入号码簿。

senses.en: (of a company's shares) not traded on a stock exchange

example.en: The firm remained unlisted despite its large profits.
example.zh: 尽管利润丰厚，这家公司仍未上市。

senses.en: shining softly with light or bright color; excited
senses.zh: 发光的；红彤彤的；兴奋的

example.en: Her face was aglow with happiness.
example.zh: 她的脸上洋溢着幸福的光彩。

senses.en: the bottom of a sea or ocean

example.en: The divers explored the rocky seabed.
example.zh: 潜水员探索了岩石遍布的海底。

senses.en: a person who pays local taxes, especially a householder
senses.zh: 地方税纳税人；（英）地方税款缴纳人

example.en: Ratepayers objected to the increase in local charges.
example.zh: 纳税人反对地方收费上涨。

senses.en: so excellent that no one or nothing else can equal it
senses.zh: 无与伦比的；出类拔萃的

example.en: The critic described her as a peerless musician.
example.zh: 这位评论家称她为无与伦比的音乐家。

senses.en: sounding loud, rough and unpleasant

example.en: We could hear raucous laughter from the next room.
example.zh: 我们能听到隔壁房间刺耳的笑声。

senses.en: noisy and rowdy

example.en: The raucous crowd cheered until midnight.
example.zh: 喧闹的人群欢呼到午夜。

senses.en: a person who is not present at a place or event where they are expected

example.en: Three employees were absentees on Monday.
example.zh: 周一有三名员工缺勤。

senses.en: a person who designs and arranges dances

example.en: The choreographer spent weeks creating the dance for the musical.
example.zh: 这位编舞者花了数周时间为音乐剧设计舞蹈。

senses.en: a person who disagrees with an official opinion or accepted belief

example.en: Several dissenters spoke out against the new policy.
example.zh: 几位持异议者公开反对新政策。

senses.en: done quickly without careful attention

example.en: He gave the report only a cursory glance.
example.zh: 他只是粗略地扫了一眼报告。

senses.en: a person chosen to settle a dispute between two sides

example.en: Both companies agreed to appoint an independent arbitrator.
example.zh: 两家公司都同意指定一位独立仲裁人。
